          <feGaussianBlur in="SourceGraphic" stdDeviation="1.5" result="blur1"/>
          <feFlood flood-color="#a050f0" flood-opacity="0.75" result="violet"/>
          <feComposite in="violet" in2="blur1" operator="in" result="violetGlow"/>
          <feGaussianBlur in="SourceGraphic" stdDeviation="4" result="blur2"/>
          <feFlood flood-color="#be5aeb" flood-opacity="0.45" result="magenta"/>
          <feComposite in="magenta" in2="blur2" operator="in" result="magentaGlow"/>
          <feGaussianBlur in="SourceGraphic" stdDeviation="8" result="blur3"/>
          <feFlood flood-color="#ffaa50" flood-opacity="0.30" result="amber"/>
          <feComposite in="amber" in2="blur3" operator="in" result="amberGlow"/>
          <feMerge>
            <feMergeNode in="amberGlow"/>
            <feMergeNode in="magentaGlow"/>
            <feMergeNode in="violetGlow"/>
            <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
          </feMerge>
        </filter>
        <!-- Speaking-state aura: wider, more vibrant, with a fourth deep-violet outer halo. -->
        <filter id="netra-violet-glow-speaking" x="-80%" y="-80%" width="260%" height="260%">
          <feGaussianBlur in="SourceGraphic" stdDeviation="2" result="b1"/>
          <feFlood flood-color="#a050f0" flood-opacity="0.90" result="c1"/>
          <feComposite in="c1" in2="b1" operator="in" result="g1"/>
          <feGaussianBlur in="SourceGraphic" stdDeviation="6" result="b2"/>
          <feFlood flood-color="#be5aeb" flood-opacity="0.60" result="c2"/>
          <feComposite in="c2" in2="b2" operator="in" result="g2"/>
          <feGaussianBlur in="SourceGraphic" stdDeviation="11" result="b3"/>
          <feFlood flood-color="#ffaa50" flood-opacity="0.40" result="c3"/>
          <feComposite in="c3" in2="b3" operator="in" result="g3"/>
          <feGaussianBlur in="SourceGraphic" stdDeviation="18" result="b4"/>
          <feFlood flood-color="#8b3df0" flood-opacity="0.18" result="c4"/>
          <feComposite in="c4" in2="b4" operator="in" result="g4"/>
          <feMerge>
            <feMergeNode in="g4"/>
            <feMergeNode in="g3"/>
            <feMergeNode in="g2"/>
            <feMergeNode in="g1"/>
            <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
          </feMerge>
        </filter>
      </defs>

      <!-- ALL geometry centred at 60,60 in the 120x120 viewBox so we
           have room around the sphere for drop shadow + halo bleed -->

      <!-- R2.8.2 - AUDIO-REACTIVE VOICE RING
           24 outer points computed in client.js as c.voiceRingPoints
           "x1,y1 x2,y2 ..." Single polygon connects all 24 tops; an
           outer stroke polyline traces the connected waveform.
           Filled with a translucent gradient so it reads as a halo
           of energy outside the sphere. Spike multiplier 2x the
           previous (0.40-0.50 vs 0.18-0.25). -->
      <g class="netra-voice-ring-group" ng-show="c.alert">
        <!-- Filled waveform polygon: case-hardened violet patina inside the
             ring outline. Same SVG glow filter as the stroke so the fill
             reads as a soft inner aura rather than a flat color. -->
        <polygon class="netra-voice-ring-fill"
                 ng-attr-points="{{c.voiceRingPoints}}"
                 fill="url(#netra-voice-gradient)"
                 stroke="none"
                 ng-attr-filter="{{c.state === 'speaking' ? 'url(#netra-violet-glow-speaking)' : 'url(#netra-violet-glow)'}}"/>
        <!-- Outer connected outline: case-hardened violet stroke gradient.
             SVG `filter` attribute is the OOB-correct way to layer glows on
             SVG geometry — the SCSS compiler can't strip this. Two filters:
             one for the idle/listening state, swap to the speaking variant
             via ng-attr-filter when state=speaking. -->
        <polygon class="netra-voice-ring-stroke"
                 ng-attr-points="{{c.voiceRingPoints}}"
                 fill="none"
                 stroke="url(#netra-voice-stroke-gradient)"
                 stroke-width="1.4"
                 stroke-linejoin="round"
                 ng-attr-filter="{{c.state === 'speaking' ? 'url(#netra-violet-glow-speaking)' : 'url(#netra-violet-glow)'}}"/>
      </g>

      <!-- Outermost soft halo, pulses via CSS -->
      <circle class="netra-eye-halo" cx="60" cy="60" r="58" fill="url(#netra-halo)"/>

      <!-- The 3D sphere (r=50, the unit) -->
      <g filter="url(#netra-drop)">
        <circle class="netra-eye-sphere" cx="60" cy="60" r="50" fill="url(#netra-sphere)"/>
        <!-- Inner ring/cast shadow gives the look of an inset orb -->
        <circle cx="60" cy="60" r="50" fill="url(#netra-inner-shadow)"/>
        <!-- Rim light from lower-right (golden-angle counter-light) -->
        <circle cx="60" cy="60" r="50" fill="url(#netra-rim)"/>
      </g>

      <!-- LIMBAL RING at radius 50/phi = 30.901 (the dark band marking
           where iris meets sclera in a healthy human eye) -->
      <circle class="netra-eye-iris" cx="60" cy="60" r="30.901" fill="none"
              stroke="rgba(0,20,10,0.45)" stroke-width="1.2"/>

      <!-- IRIS MID-BAND at radius 50/phi^2 = 19.098 - subtle ring -->
      <circle cx="60" cy="60" r="19.098" fill="none"
              stroke="var(--iris-bright, rgba(127,255,176,0.55))" stroke-width="0.5"
              stroke-dasharray="2 3" opacity="0.6"/>

      <!-- INSCRIBED PENTAGRAM (homage to da Vinci) - five vertices
           at radius 19.098 around centre, drawn as a connected star.
           Vertex angles: -90, -18, 54, 126, 198 degrees.
           Each line skips one vertex to make the star. -->
      <g class="netra-eye-pentagram" opacity="0.18">
        <polygon
          points="60,40.902 78.166,53.106 71.235,74.453 48.765,74.453 41.834,53.106"
          fill="none"
          stroke="var(--iris-bright, #aef0d0)" stroke-width="0.4"/>
        <!-- The actual five-pointed star formed by connecting every other vertex -->
        <path d="M 60 40.902 L 71.235 74.453 L 41.834 53.106 L 78.166 53.106 L 48.765 74.453 Z"
              fill="none" stroke="var(--iris-bright, #aef0d0)" stroke-width="0.5"/>
      </g>

      <!-- IRIS INNER at radius 50/phi^3 = 11.803 - pupil border ring -->
      <circle cx="60" cy="60" r="11.803" fill="none"
              stroke="var(--iris-bright, rgba(127,255,176,0.7))" stroke-width="0.5"/>

      <!-- PUPIL at radius 50/phi^4 = 7.295 -->
      <circle class="netra-eye-pupil" cx="60" cy="60" r="7.295" fill="url(#netra-pupil)"/>

      <!-- PRIMARY CATCHLIGHT at the golden-section point.
           Distance from centre = 0.382 * 50 = 19.098.
           Angle = 137.5 degrees (the golden angle from +x axis),
           which lands the catchlight in the upper-left quadrant.
           cx = 60 + 19.098 * cos(137.5 deg) = 60 + 19.098 * -0.7373 = 45.92
           cy = 60 - 19.098 * sin(137.5 deg) = 60 - 19.098 *  0.6756 = 47.10
           Catchlight radius = 50/phi^5 = 4.508 -->
      <ellipse class="netra-eye-glint" cx="45.92" cy="47.1" rx="4.508" ry="3.6"
               fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.92"/>
      <ellipse cx="45.92" cy="47.1" rx="2.4" ry="1.8" fill="#ffffff"/>

      <!-- SECONDARY CATCHLIGHT at the OPPOSITE golden-section point.
           Distance 0.382 * 50 = 19.098, angle = 137.5 + 180 = 317.5 deg,
           which lands in the lower-right quadrant.
           cx = 60 + 19.098 * cos(317.5) = 60 + 19.098 *  0.7373 = 74.08
           cy = 60 - 19.098 * sin(317.5) = 60 - 19.098 * -0.6756 = 72.90
           Radius = 50/phi^6 = 2.787 -->
      <circle class="netra-eye-glint-small" cx="74.08" cy="72.9" r="2.787"
              fill="rgba(255,255,255,0.55)"/>

      <!-- Eyelid (only used in dormant state - covers iris when closed) -->
      <circle class="netra-eye-lid-top" cx="60" cy="60" r="50" fill="#0a1a14" opacity="0"/>
    </svg>
  </button>

  <!-- Transcript card REMOVED in R2.12.2.
       For end users, screen-reader narration via the aria-live regions
       above is the canonical interface. The transcript card was the
       yellow-marked element the user asked to remove permanently;
       the popup-blocked fallback link moved to the dev panel only. -->
  <a class="netra-card-link" ng-show="c.pendingOpenUrl"
     ng-href="{{c.pendingOpenUrl}}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"
     ng-click="c.pendingOpenUrl = null">Click here to open {{c.pendingOpenUrl}}</a>

  <!-- Initial-gesture gate -->
  <button class="netra-gate"
          ng-show="c.needsTap"
          ng-click="c.tap()"
          aria-label="Press here to start Netra. Press once and Netra will begin listening.">
    <span class="netra-gate-icon" aria-hidden="true">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="34" height="34"><path fill="currentColor" d="M12 14a3 3 0 0 0 3-3V5a3 3 0 0 0-6 0v6a3 3 0 0 0 3 3zm5-3a5 5 0 0 1-10 0H5a7 7 0 0 0 6 6.92V22h2v-4.08A7 7 0 0 0 19 11z"/></svg>
    </span>
    <span class="netra-gate-text">
      <strong>Press here to start Netra</strong>
      <span>Always listening. Just speak naturally. Say "stop listening" to pause.</span>
    </span>
  </button>

</div>
]]></template></sp_widget></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_include_419c876c93428b10e3aef0aefaba1093
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_196061_netra_v1.NetraVulnerability</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Vulnerability Response analyst operations: triage, exposure, CVE lookup, assign, state, defer, notes.</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>NetraVulnerability</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[/**
 * NetraVulnerability — server-side Vulnerability Response (VR) operations for
 * the Netra voice assistant. Gives Netra full coverage of a vulnerability
 * analyst's day: triage the queue, understand exposure, look up CVEs, assign,
 * investigate, defer, resolve and close Vulnerable Items (VITs), and reason
 * about the riskiest assets.
 *
 * R5 adds: role gates (_canRead/_canWrite), encoded-query sanitizing (_q),
 * overdue and aging analytics, close / false-positive / reopen flows,
 * deferral with a review date, vulnerability group operations, bulk
 * preview-then-apply, change creation from a VIT, opened-vs-closed trends,
 * vulnerability library search, and a triage queue walker.
 *
 * Tables (ServiceNow Vulnerability Response, global scope):
 *   sn_vul_vulnerable_item   Vulnerable Item (VIT) — the analyst's work unit
 *   sn_vul_entry             Vulnerability entry (the CVE / advisory)
 *   sn_vul_vulnerability_group  Remediation grouping
 *
 * Every method returns { ok: true, ... } or { ok: false, error }. Results are
 * shaped for spoken read-back: numbers, risk bands, CI names, states as words.
 * Fields not guaranteed on every VR install (substate, remediation_target,
 * change_request, vulnerability_group, closed_at) are guarded with
 * isValidField() and degrade gracefully.
 */
var NetraVulnerability = Class.create();
NetraVulnerability.prototype = {

    VIT:   'sn_vul_vulnerable_item',
    ENTRY: 'sn_vul_entry',
    GROUP: 'sn_vul_vulnerability_group',

    // sn_vul_vulnerable_item.state choices on this instance
    STATE: {
        OPEN: '1', UNDER_INVESTIGATION: '2', AWAITING_IMPLEMENTATION: '10',
        IN_REVIEW: '11', DEFERRED: '12', RESOLVED: '101', CLOSED: '3'
    },
    STATE_LABEL: {
        '1': 'open', '2': 'under investigation', '10': 'awaiting implementation',
        '11': 'in review', '12': 'deferred', '101': 'resolved', '3': 'closed'
    },
    // spoken word -> state value (what the analyst says -> what we set)
    STATE_WORD: {
        'open': '1', 'reopen': '1',
        'investigate': '2', 'investigating': '2', 'under investigation': '2', 'in progress': '2',
        'awaiting': '10', 'awaiting implementation': '10', 'implement': '10',
        'review': '11', 'in review': '11',
        'defer': '12', 'deferred': '12', 'accept risk': '12', 'risk accept': '12',
        'resolve': '101', 'resolved': '101', 'remediate': '101', 'remediated': '101', 'fixed': '101',
        'close': '3', 'closed': '3'
    },

    initialize: function () {
        this.userSysId = gs.getUserID();
        this.userName  = gs.getUserName();
    },

    // ============================================================
    //  Access control & sanitizing (R5)
    // ============================================================
    /** Can the current user READ vulnerability data through Netra? */
    _canRead: function () {
        if (gs.hasRole('admin') || gs.hasRole('sn_vul.admin') ||
            gs.hasRole('sn_vul.vulnerability_analyst') || gs.hasRole('sn_vul.vulnerability_write') ||
            gs.hasRole('sn_vul.vulnerability_read') || gs.hasRole('sn_vul.remediation_owner') ||
            gs.hasRole('sn_vul.read')) return true;
        return this._hasPropertyRole('x_196061_netra_v1.vr_read_roles');
    },

    /** Can the current user CHANGE vulnerability data through Netra? */
    _canWrite: function () {
        if (gs.hasRole('admin') || gs.hasRole('sn_vul.admin') ||
            gs.hasRole('sn_vul.vulnerability_analyst') || gs.hasRole('sn_vul.vulnerability_write') ||
            gs.hasRole('sn_vul.remediation_owner')) return true;
        return this._hasPropertyRole('x_196061_netra_v1.vr_write_roles');
    },

    /** True if the user holds any role from the comma-list in the property. */
    _hasPropertyRole: function (propName) {
        var extra = String(gs.getProperty(propName, '') || '');
        if (!extra) return false;
        var parts = extra.split(',');
        for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
            var r = parts[i].trim();
            if (r && gs.hasRole(r)) return true;
        }
        return false;
    },

    _denyRead: function () {
        return { ok: false, error: 'You need a Vulnerability Response role to view vulnerability data. Ask your admin for sn_vul.vulnerability_analyst.' };
    },

    _denyWrite: function () {
        return { ok: false, error: 'You need a Vulnerability Response write role to change vulnerability data. Ask your admin for sn_vul.vulnerability_analyst.' };
    },

    _q: function (s) {
        // sanitize a value destined for an encoded query: strip caret/quote/backslash
        return String(s || '').replace(/[\^"'\\]/g, ' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
    },

    // ============================================================
    //  Helpers
    // ============================================================
    _normVit: function (num) {
        num = String(num || '').toUpperCase().replace(/\s+/g, '');
        if (/^\d+$/.test(num)) num = 'VIT' + ('0000000' + num).slice(-7);
        return num;
    },

    _riskBand: function (score) {
        score = parseInt(score, 10) || 0;
        if (score >= 80) return 'critical';
        if (score >= 60) return 'high';
        if (score >= 40) return 'medium';
        if (score > 0)   return 'low';
        return 'none';
    },

    _myGroupIds: function () {
        var ids = [];
        var gm = new GlideRecord('sys_user_grmember');
        gm.addQuery('user', this.userSysId);
        gm.query();
        while (gm.next()) ids.push(String(gm.group));
        return ids;
    },

    /** Encoded query for 'my' VITs: assigned to me OR to one of my groups. */
    _meQuery: function () {
        var groups = this._myGroupIds();
        var q = 'assigned_to=' + this.userSysId;
        if (groups.length) q += '^ORassignment_groupIN' + groups.join(',');
        return q;
    },

    /** Whole days since first_found (falling back to sys_created_on). */
    _daysOpen: function (gr) {
        var from = gr.first_found.nil() ? String(gr.sys_created_on) : String(gr.first_found);
        if (!from) return 0;
        var ms = new GlideDateTime().getNumericValue() - new GlideDateTime(from).getNumericValue();
        if (ms < 0) ms = 0;
        return Math.floor(ms / (24 * 3600 * 1000));
    },

    _shapeVit: function (gr) {
        return {
            number:      String(gr.number),
            sys_id:      String(gr.sys_id),
            summary:     String(gr.short_description),
            risk_score:  parseInt(String(gr.risk_score), 10) || 0,
            risk_band:   this._riskBand(gr.risk_score),
            state:       String(gr.state),
            state_label: this.STATE_LABEL[String(gr.state)] || ('state ' + gr.state),
            ci:          gr.cmdb_ci.nil() ? '' : String(gr.cmdb_ci.getDisplayValue()),
            cve:         gr.vulnerability.nil() ? '' : String(gr.vulnerability.getDisplayValue()),
            group:       gr.assignment_group.nil() ? '' : String(gr.assignment_group.getDisplayValue()),
            assigned_to: gr.assigned_to.nil() ? '' : String(gr.assigned_to.getDisplayValue()),
            first_found: gr.first_found.nil() ? '' : String(gr.first_found.getDisplayValue()),
            days_open:   this._daysOpen(gr)
        };
    },

    _findVit: function (number) {
        var gr = new GlideRecord(this.VIT);
        if (gr.get('number', this._normVit(number))) return gr;
        return null;
    },

    /** Add "(first_found OR sys_created_on) older than N days" to a query. */
    _applyOlderThan: function (gr, days) {
        var cutoff = new GlideDateTime();
        cutoff.subtract(days * 24 * 3600 * 1000);
        gr.addQuery('first_found', '<', cutoff).addOrCondition('sys_created_on', '<', cutoff);
    },

    _overdueDays: function () {
        var d = parseInt(gs.getProperty('x_196061_netra_v1.vr_overdue_days', '30'), 10);
        return (d && d > 0) ? d : 30;
    },

    /**
     * Add the overdue conditions to a query (caller adds active=true).
     * Returns the basis used: 'remediation_target' when the field exists,
     * else 'age' (open, not deferred, older than the configured day count).
     */
    _applyOverdueFilter: function (gr) {
        if (gr.isValidField('remediation_target')) {
            gr.addNotNullQuery('remediation_target');
            gr.addQuery('remediation_target', '<', new GlideDateTime());
            return 'remediation_target';
        }
        gr.addQuery('state', 'NOT IN', this.STATE.CLOSED + ',' + this.STATE.RESOLVED + ',' + this.STATE.DEFERRED);
        this._applyOlderThan(gr, this._overdueDays());
        return 'age';
    },

    /**
     * Resolve a spoken group name to exactly one sys_user_group.
     * Returns {ok:true, sys_id, name} or {ok:false, error, candidates?} when
     * nothing or more than one group matches (disambiguation for voice).
     */
    _resolveGroup: function (name) {
        var clean = this._q(name);
        if (!clean) return { ok: false, error: 'Which group should I use?' };
        var gg = new GlideRecord('sys_user_group');
        gg.addQuery('active', true);
        gg.addEncodedQuery('nameLIKE' + clean);
        gg.setLimit(10);
        gg.query();
        var hits = [];
        while (gg.next()) hits.push({ sys_id: String(gg.sys_id), name: String(gg.name) });
        if (!hits.length) return { ok: false, error: 'No group matching "' + clean + '".' };
        if (hits.length > 1) {
            var names = [];
            for (var i = 0; i < hits.length && i < 3; i++) names.push(hits[i].name);
            return {
                ok: false,
                error: 'I found ' + hits.length + ' groups matching ' + clean + ': ' + names.join(', ') + '. Which one?',
                candidates: names
            };
        }
        return { ok: true, sys_id: hits[0].sys_id, name: hits[0].name };
    },

    /** Resolve a spoken user name/username/email to exactly one sys_user. */
    _resolveUser: function (name) {
        var clean = this._q(name);
        if (!clean) return { ok: false, error: 'Which user should I use?' };
        var u = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
        u.addQuery('active', true);
        u.addEncodedQuery('nameLIKE' + clean + '^ORuser_nameLIKE' + clean + '^ORemailLIKE' + clean);
        u.setLimit(10);
        u.query();
        var hits = [];
        while (u.next()) hits.push({ sys_id: String(u.sys_id), name: String(u.name) });
        if (!hits.length) return { ok: false, error: 'No user matching "' + clean + '".' };
        if (hits.length > 1) {
            var names = [];
            for (var i = 0; i < hits.length && i < 3; i++) names.push(hits[i].name);
            return {
                ok: false,
                error: 'I found ' + hits.length + ' users matching ' + clean + ': ' + names.join(', ') + '. Which one?',
                candidates: names
            };
        }
        return { ok: true, sys_id: hits[0].sys_id, name: hits[0].name };
    },

    // ============================================================
    //  Triage & read
    // ============================================================
    /**
     * List vulnerable items with flexible analyst filters.
     * opts: { scope:'me'|'group'|'all', state, min_risk, band, ci, cve,
     *         group, older_than_days, sla:'overdue', limit }
     */
    listVulnerableItems: function (opts) {
        if (!this._canRead()) return this._denyRead();
        opts = opts || {};
        var gr = new GlideRecord(this.VIT);
        gr.addQuery('active', true);

        var scope = String(opts.scope || 'me').toLowerCase();
        if (scope === 'me') {
            gr.addEncodedQuery(this._meQuery());
        } else if (scope === 'group') {
            var g2 = this._myGroupIds();
            if (g2.length) gr.addQuery('assignment_group', 'IN', g2.join(','));
            else return { ok: true, count: 0, items: [], note: 'You are not a member of any assignment group.' };
        }

        if (opts.state) {
            var st = this.STATE_WORD[String(opts.state).toLowerCase()] || String(opts.state);
            gr.addQuery('state', st);
        }
        if (opts.min_risk) gr.addQuery('risk_score', '>=', parseInt(opts.min_risk, 10) || 0);
        if (opts.band) {
            var b = String(opts.band).toLowerCase();
            var ranges = { critical: [80, 100], high: [60, 79], medium: [40, 59], low: [1, 39] };
            if (ranges[b]) { gr.addQuery('risk_score', '>=', ranges[b][0]); gr.addQuery('risk_score', '<=', ranges[b][1]); }
        }
        if (opts.ci)  gr.addQuery('cmdb_ci.name', 'CONTAINS', this._q(opts.ci));
        if (opts.cve) gr.addQuery('vulnerability.id', this._q(opts.cve).toUpperCase());
        if (opts.group) gr.addQuery('assignment_group.name', 'CONTAINS', this._q(opts.group));
        if (opts.older_than_days) {
            var otd = parseInt(opts.older_than_days, 10);
            if (otd > 0) this._applyOlderThan(gr, otd);
        }
        if (String(opts.sla || '').toLowerCase() === 'overdue') this._applyOverdueFilter(gr);

        gr.orderByDesc('risk_score');
        gr.setLimit(parseInt(opts.limit, 10) || 10);
        gr.query();
        var items = [];
        while (gr.next()) items.push(this._shapeVit(gr));
        return { ok: true, count: items.length, scope: scope, items: items };
    },

    /** Highest-risk active vulnerable items across the whole org (exposure view). */
    topRisk: function (limit) {
        if (!this._canRead()) return this._denyRead();
        var gr = new GlideRecord(this.VIT);
        gr.addQuery('active', true);
        gr.addQuery('state', 'NOT IN', this.STATE.CLOSED + ',' + this.STATE.RESOLVED);
        gr.orderByDesc('risk_score');
        gr.setLimit(parseInt(limit, 10) || 5);
        gr.query();
        var items = [];
        while (gr.next()) items.push(this._shapeVit(gr));
        return { ok: true, count: items.length, items: items };
    },

    /** Full detail of one VIT, including CVE summary and remediation solution. */
    getVulnerableItem: function (number) {
        if (!this._canRead()) return this._denyRead();
        var gr = this._findVit(number);
        if (!gr) return { ok: false, error: 'Vulnerable item ' + this._normVit(number) + ' not found.' };
        var out = this._shapeVit(gr);
        out.ok = true;
        out.notes = String(gr.work_notes.getJournalEntry(1) || '').substring(0, 600);
        // pull the CVE entry for summary + solution
        if (!gr.vulnerability.nil()) {
            var e = new GlideRecord(this.ENTRY);
            if (e.get(String(gr.vulnerability))) {
                out.cve_id      = String(e.id);
                out.cve_summary = String(e.summary || '').substring(0, 800);
                out.cve_source  = String(e.source || '');
                out.solution    = this._stripHtml(String(e.solution || '')).substring(0, 800);
            }
        }
        return out;
    },

    /** Look up a CVE / advisory by id (e.g. CVE-2014-0322) and how it hits us. */
    lookupCVE: function (cveId) {
        if (!this._canRead()) return this._denyRead();
        cveId = this._q(cveId).toUpperCase().replace(/\s+/g, '');
        if (!cveId) return { ok: false, error: 'Which CVE? Give me an identifier like CVE-2021-44228.' };
        var e = new GlideRecord(this.ENTRY);
        e.addQuery('id', cveId);
        e.setLimit(1); e.query();
        if (!e.next()) return { ok: false, error: 'No vulnerability entry for ' + cveId + ' in the library.' };
        // how many active VITs reference it, and the worst risk
        var agg = new GlideAggregate(this.VIT);
        agg.addQuery('vulnerability', String(e.sys_id));
        agg.addQuery('active', true);
        agg.addAggregate('COUNT');
        agg.addAggregate('MAX', 'risk_score');
        agg.query();
        var affected = 0, worst = 0;
        if (agg.next()) { affected = parseInt(agg.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) || 0; worst = parseInt(agg.getAggregate('MAX', 'risk_score'), 10) || 0; }
        return {
            ok: true,
            cve_id: cveId,
            summary: String(e.summary || '').substring(0, 900),
            source:  String(e.source || ''),
            solution: this._stripHtml(String(e.solution || '')).substring(0, 900),
            affected_items: affected,
            worst_risk: worst,
            worst_band: this._riskBand(worst)
        };
    },

    /**
     * Vulnerable items past their due date.
     * Basis 'remediation_target' when the field exists (target date passed),
     * else 'age' (open, not deferred, older than vr_overdue_days, default 30).
     */
    overdueItems: function (limit) {
        if (!this._canRead()) return this._denyRead();
        var gr = new GlideRecord(this.VIT);
        gr.addQuery('active', true);
        var basis = this._applyOverdueFilter(gr);
        gr.orderByDesc('risk_score');
        gr.setLimit(parseInt(limit, 10) || 10);
        gr.query();
        var hasTarget = (basis === 'remediation_target');
        var items = [];
        while (gr.next()) {
            var it = this._shapeVit(gr);
            it.target = (hasTarget && !gr.remediation_target.nil()) ? String(gr.remediation_target.getDisplayValue()) : '';
            items.push(it);
        }
        return { ok: true, count: items.length, basis: basis, items: items };
    },

    /**
     * How stale is the open queue? Buckets by age (first_found else created),
     * the 3 oldest items, and deferred items whose review date has passed
     * (remediation_target based when the field exists; 0 otherwise — cheap).
     */
    agingReport: function () {
        if (!this._canRead()) return this._denyRead();
        var buckets = { fresh_0_7: 0, week_7_30: 0, month_30_90: 0, stale_90_plus: 0 };
        var oldest = [];
        var gr = new GlideRecord(this.VIT);
        gr.addQuery('active', true);
        gr.addQuery('state', 'NOT IN', this.STATE.CLOSED + ',' + this.STATE.RESOLVED);
        gr.setLimit(1000);  // defensive cap — aging is indicative, not an audit
        gr.query();
        while (gr.next()) {
            var d = this._daysOpen(gr);
            if (d < 7) buckets.fresh_0_7++;
            else if (d < 30) buckets.week_7_30++;
            else if (d < 90) buckets.month_30_90++;
            else buckets.stale_90_plus++;
            if (oldest.length < 3 || d > oldest[oldest.length - 1].days_open) {
                oldest.push(this._shapeVit(gr));
                oldest.sort(function (a, b) { return b.days_open - a.days_open; });
                if (oldest.length > 3) oldest.pop();
            }
        }
        var pastReview = 0;
        var probe = new GlideRecord(this.VIT);
        if (probe.isValidField('remediation_target')) {
            var agg = new GlideAggregate(this.VIT);
            agg.addQuery('state', this.STATE.DEFERRED);
            agg.addNotNullQuery('remediation_target');
            agg.addQuery('remediation_target', '<', new GlideDateTime());
            agg.addAggregate('COUNT');
            agg.query();
            if (agg.next()) pastReview = parseInt(agg.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) || 0;
        }
        return { ok: true, buckets: buckets, oldest: oldest, deferred_past_review: pastReview };
    },

    /**
     * The single highest-risk item the analyst should look at next.
     * My queue first (assigned to me or my groups, state open/investigating);
     * falls back to unassigned org-wide. excludeNumbers = comma list of VIT
     * numbers already walked past in this session.
     */
    nextTriageItem: function (excludeNumbers) {
        if (!this._canRead()) return this._denyRead();
        var excl = [];
        var parts = String(excludeNumbers || '').split(',');
        for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
            var p = parts[i].trim();
            if (p) excl.push(this._normVit(p));
        }
        var triageStates = this.STATE.OPEN + ',' + this.STATE.UNDER_INVESTIGATION;

        var gr = new GlideRecord(this.VIT);
        gr.addQuery('active', true);
        gr.addQuery('state', 'IN', triageStates);
        gr.addEncodedQuery(this._meQuery());
        if (excl.length) gr.addQuery('number', 'NOT IN', excl.join(','));
        gr.orderByDesc('risk_score');
        gr.setLimit(100);
        gr.query();

        var item = null, remaining = 0, pool = 'yours';
        if (gr.next()) {
            item = this._shapeVit(gr);
            while (gr.next()) remaining++;
        } else {
            var ua = new GlideRecord(this.VIT);
            ua.addQuery('active', true);
            ua.addQuery('state', 'IN', triageStates);
            ua.addNullQuery('assigned_to');
            if (excl.length) ua.addQuery('number', 'NOT IN', excl.join(','));
            ua.orderByDesc('risk_score');
            ua.setLimit(100);
            ua.query();
            if (ua.next()) {
                item = this._shapeVit(ua);
                pool = 'unassigned';
                while (ua.next()) remaining++;
            }
        }
        if (!item) return { ok: true, item: null, remaining: 0, message: 'Queue is clear. No open vulnerable items need your attention right now.' };
        return { ok: true, item: item, remaining: remaining, pool: pool };
    },

    /**
     * Keyword search over the vulnerability library (sn_vul_entry).
     * Tokenizes the keyword, narrows on the longest word, scores by overlap.
     */
    searchVulnLibrary: function (keyword, limit) {
        if (!this._canRead()) return this._denyRead();
        var q = String(keyword || '').trim();
        if (q.length < 2) return { ok: false, error: 'What should I search the vulnerability library for?' };
        var words = q.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9\s]/g, ' ').split(/\s+/);
        var keywords = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < words.length; i++) {
            if (words[i].length >= 3) keywords.push(words[i]);
        }
        if (!keywords.length) {
            for (var w = 0; w < words.length; w++) if (words[w]) keywords.push(words[w]);
        }
        if (!keywords.length) return { ok: false, error: 'What should I search the vulnerability library for?' };
        keywords.sort(function (a, b) { return b.length - a.length; });
        var primary = keywords[0];

        var e = new GlideRecord(this.ENTRY);
        if (!e.isValid()) return { ok: false, error: 'The vulnerability library is not available on this instance.' };
        e.addEncodedQuery('summaryLIKE' + primary);
        e.setLimit(40);
        e.query();
        var scored = [];
        while (e.next()) {
            var summary = String(e.summary || '');
            var hay = summary.toLowerCase() + ' ' + String(e.id || '').toLowerCase();
            var score = 0;
            for (var k = 0; k < keywords.length; k++) {
                if (hay.indexOf(keywords[k]) >= 0) score++;
            }
            if (score > 0) scored.push({ id: String(e.id), sys_id: String(e.sys_id), summary: summary.substring(0, 300), score: score });
        }
        scored.sort(function (a, b) { return b.score - a.score; });
        var top = scored.slice(0, parseInt(limit, 10) || 5);
        var entries = [];
        for (var t = 0; t < top.length; t++) {
            var entry = { id: top[t].id, summary: top[t].summary };
            if (t < 5) {  // aggregate budget: at most 5 count queries per call
                var agg = new GlideAggregate(this.VIT);
                agg.addQuery('vulnerability', top[t].sys_id);
                agg.addQuery('active', true);
                agg.addAggregate('COUNT');
                agg.query();
                entry.affected_items = agg.next() ? (parseInt(agg.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) || 0) : 0;
            }
            entries.push(entry);
        }
        return { ok: true, count: entries.length, entries: entries };
    },

    // ============================================================
    //  Vulnerability groups (R5)
    // ============================================================
    /**
     * List remediation groups. opts: { state, limit }. open_items counts come
     * from one aggregate over vulnerable items when the link field exists.
     */
    listGroups: function (opts) {
        if (!this._canRead()) return this._denyRead();
        opts = opts || {};
        var gr = new GlideRecord(this.GROUP);
        if (!gr.isValid()) return { ok: false, error: 'Vulnerability groups are not available on this instance.' };
        if (opts.state) gr.addQuery('state', String(opts.state));
        else gr.addQuery('active', true);
        gr.orderByDesc('sys_updated_on');
        gr.setLimit(parseInt(opts.limit, 10) || 10);
        gr.query();

        var counts = null;
        var probe = new GlideRecord(this.VIT);
        if (probe.isValidField('vulnerability_group')) {
            counts = {};
            var agg = new GlideAggregate(this.VIT);
            agg.addQuery('active', true);
            agg.addNotNullQuery('vulnerability_group');
            agg.addAggregate('COUNT');
            agg.groupBy('vulnerability_group');
            agg.query();
            while (agg.next()) counts[String(agg.vulnerability_group)] = parseInt(agg.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) || 0;
        }

        var groups = [];
        while (gr.next()) {
            var g = {
                number:      String(gr.number),
                sys_id:      String(gr.sys_id),
                name:        String(gr.short_description),
                state_label: String(gr.state.getDisplayValue() || '') || ('state ' + gr.state),
                assigned_to: gr.assigned_to.nil() ? '' : String(gr.assigned_to.getDisplayValue()),
                group:       gr.assignment_group.nil() ? '' : String(gr.assignment_group.getDisplayValue())
            };
            if (counts !== null) g.open_items = counts[String(gr.sys_id)] || 0;
            groups.push(g);
        }
        return { ok: true, count: groups.length, groups: groups };
    },

    /** One group by number (VUL...) or name fragment, with up to 5 member VITs. */
    getGroup: function (numberOrName) {
        if (!this._canRead()) return this._denyRead();
        var raw = String(numberOrName || '').trim();
        if (!raw) return { ok: false, error: 'Which vulnerability group? Give me a number or a name.' };
        var gr = new GlideRecord(this.GROUP);
        if (!gr.isValid()) return { ok: false, error: 'Vulnerability groups are not available on this instance.' };

        var norm = raw.toUpperCase().replace(/\s+/g, '');
        var found = false;
        if (/^[A-Z]+\d+$/.test(norm)) {
            gr.addQuery('number', norm);
            gr.setLimit(1);
            gr.query();
            found = gr.next();
        }
        if (!found) {
            gr = new GlideRecord(this.GROUP);
            gr.addQuery('short_description', 'CONTAINS', this._q(raw));
            gr.setLimit(1);
            gr.query();
            found = gr.next();
        }
        if (!found) return { ok: false, error: 'No vulnerability group matching "' + this._q(raw) + '".' };

        var out = {
            ok:          true,
            number:      String(gr.number),
            sys_id:      String(gr.sys_id),
            name:        String(gr.short_description),
            state_label: String(gr.state.getDisplayValue() || '') || ('state ' + gr.state),
            assigned_to: gr.assigned_to.nil() ? '' : String(gr.assigned_to.getDisplayValue()),
            group:       gr.assignment_group.nil() ? '' : String(gr.assignment_group.getDisplayValue()),
            items:       []
        };
        var probe = new GlideRecord(this.VIT);
        if (probe.isValidField('vulnerability_group')) {
            var agg = new GlideAggregate(this.VIT);
            agg.addQuery('vulnerability_group', out.sys_id);
            agg.addQuery('active', true);
            agg.addAggregate('COUNT');
            agg.query();
            out.open_items = agg.next() ? (parseInt(agg.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) || 0) : 0;

            var v = new GlideRecord(this.VIT);
            v.addQuery('vulnerability_group', out.sys_id);
            v.addQuery('active', true);
            v.orderByDesc('risk_score');
            v.setLimit(5);
            v.query();
            while (v.next()) out.items.push(this._shapeVit(v));
        }
        return out;
    },

    // ============================================================
    //  Exposure analytics
    // ============================================================
    /** Org-wide exposure snapshot: counts by state, risk band, top groups & CVEs. */
    exposureSummary: function () {
        if (!this._canRead()) return this._denyRead();
        var out = { ok: true };

        // by risk band (active, not closed/resolved)
        var bands = { critical: 0, high: 0, medium: 0, low: 0 };
        var byBand = new GlideAggregate(this.VIT);
        byBand.addQuery('active', true);
        byBand.addQuery('state', 'NOT IN', this.STATE.CLOSED + ',' + this.STATE.RESOLVED);
        byBand.addAggregate('COUNT');
        byBand.groupBy('risk_score');
        byBand.query();
        var totalOpen = 0;
        while (byBand.next()) {
            var c = parseInt(byBand.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) || 0;
            totalOpen += c;
            bands[this._riskBand(byBand.risk_score)] = (bands[this._riskBand(byBand.risk_score)] || 0) + c;
        }
        out.open_total = totalOpen;
        out.by_band = bands;

        // top 3 assignment groups by open count
        var byGroup = new GlideAggregate(this.VIT);
        byGroup.addQuery('active', true);
        byGroup.addQuery('state', 'NOT IN', this.STATE.CLOSED + ',' + this.STATE.RESOLVED);
        byGroup.addAggregate('COUNT');
        byGroup.groupBy('assignment_group');
        byGroup.orderByAggregate('COUNT');
        byGroup.query();
        out.top_groups = [];
        while (byGroup.next() && out.top_groups.length < 3) {
            if (byGroup.assignment_group.nil()) continue;
            out.top_groups.push({ group: String(byGroup.assignment_group.getDisplayValue()), count: parseInt(byGroup.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) || 0 });
        }

        // mine
        var myAgg = new GlideAggregate(this.VIT);
        myAgg.addQuery('active', true);
        var grp = this._myGroupIds();
        var mq = 'assigned_to=' + this.userSysId;
        if (grp.length) mq += '^ORassignment_groupIN' + grp.join(',');
        myAgg.addEncodedQuery(mq + '^stateNOT IN' + this.STATE.CLOSED + ',' + this.STATE.RESOLVED);
        myAgg.addAggregate('COUNT');
        myAgg.query();
        out.mine_open = myAgg.next() ? (parseInt(myAgg.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) || 0) : 0;

        return out;
    },

    /** Assets (CIs) carrying the most open vulnerable items — the riskiest hosts. */
    mostVulnerableAssets: function (limit) {
        if (!this._canRead()) return this._denyRead();
        var agg = new GlideAggregate(this.VIT);
        agg.addQuery('active', true);
        agg.addQuery('state', 'NOT IN', this.STATE.CLOSED + ',' + this.STATE.RESOLVED);
        agg.addNotNullQuery('cmdb_ci');
        agg.addAggregate('COUNT');
        agg.addAggregate('MAX', 'risk_score');
        agg.groupBy('cmdb_ci');
        agg.orderByAggregate('COUNT');
        agg.query();
        var assets = [];
        while (agg.next() && assets.length < (parseInt(limit, 10) || 5)) {
            assets.push({
                ci: String(agg.cmdb_ci.getDisplayValue()),
                open_items: parseInt(agg.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) || 0,
                worst_risk: parseInt(agg.getAggregate('MAX', 'risk_score'), 10) || 0,
                worst_band: this._riskBand(agg.getAggregate('MAX', 'risk_score'))
            });
        }
        return { ok: true, count: assets.length, assets: assets };
    },

    /** All active vulnerable items on a named asset. */
    vulnerabilitiesForCI: function (ciName) {
        if (!this._canRead()) return this._denyRead();
        if (!ciName) return { ok: false, error: 'Which asset? Give me a host or CI name.' };
        var gr = new GlideRecord(this.VIT);
        gr.addQuery('active', true);
        gr.addQuery('cmdb_ci.name', 'CONTAINS', this._q(ciName));
        gr.orderByDesc('risk_score');
        gr.setLimit(15);
        gr.query();
        var items = [];
        while (gr.next()) items.push(this._shapeVit(gr));
        return { ok: true, ci: ciName, count: items.length, items: items };
    },

    /**
     * Opened vs closed over the last N days (default 7, cap 90), current open
     * count, and mean time to remediate over items closed in the window.
     */
    vulnerabilityTrend: function (days) {
        if (!this._canRead()) return this._denyRead();
        days = parseInt(days, 10) || 7;
        if (days < 1) days = 7;
        if (days > 90) days = 90;
        var cutoff = new GlideDateTime();
        cutoff.subtract(days * 24 * 3600 * 1000);

        var probe = new GlideRecord(this.VIT);
        var closedField = probe.isValidField('closed_at') ? 'closed_at' : 'sys_updated_on';
        var closedStates = this.STATE.CLOSED + ',' + this.STATE.RESOLVED;

        var oAgg = new GlideAggregate(this.VIT);
        oAgg.addQuery('sys_created_on', '>=', cutoff);
        oAgg.addAggregate('COUNT');
        oAgg.query();
        var opened = oAgg.next() ? (parseInt(oAgg.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) || 0) : 0;

        var cAgg = new GlideAggregate(this.VIT);
        cAgg.addQuery('state', 'IN', closedStates);
        cAgg.addQuery(closedField, '>=', cutoff);
        cAgg.addAggregate('COUNT');
        cAgg.query();
        var closed = cAgg.next() ? (parseInt(cAgg.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) || 0) : 0;

        var nAgg = new GlideAggregate(this.VIT);
        nAgg.addQuery('active', true);
        nAgg.addQuery('state', 'NOT IN', closedStates);
        nAgg.addAggregate('COUNT');
        nAgg.query();
        var openNow = nAgg.next() ? (parseInt(nAgg.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) || 0) : 0;

        // MTTR over items closed in the window (cap the scan at 200 rows)
        var mttr = 0, scanned = 0, sumDays = 0;
        var cg = new GlideRecord(this.VIT);
        cg.addQuery('state', 'IN', closedStates);
        cg.addQuery(closedField, '>=', cutoff);
        cg.setLimit(200);
        cg.query();
        while (cg.next()) {
            var created = String(cg.sys_created_on);
            var done = String(cg.getValue(closedField) || '');
            if (!created || !done) continue;
            var ms = new GlideDateTime(done).getNumericValue() - new GlideDateTime(created).getNumericValue();
            if (ms < 0) ms = 0;
            sumDays += ms / (24 * 3600 * 1000);
            scanned++;
        }
        if (scanned) mttr = Math.round((sumDays / scanned) * 10) / 10;

        var message = 'Over the last ' + days + ' days: ' + opened + ' opened, ' + closed + ' closed. ' +
                      openNow + ' open right now.' +
                      (scanned ? ' Average time to close is ' + mttr + ' days.' : '');
        return { ok: true, days: days, opened: opened, closed: closed, open_now: openNow, mttr_days: mttr, message: message };
    },

    /** Tiny wrapper for briefing-style hooks: open total + counts by band. */
    vulnerabilityCounts: function () {
        if (!this._canRead()) return this._denyRead();
        var s = this.exposureSummary();
        if (!s.ok) return s;
        return { ok: true, open_total: s.open_total, by_band: s.by_band };
    },

    // ============================================================
    //  Actions (mutating — Netra confirms verbally before calling)
    // ============================================================
    assignVulnerableItem: function (number, opts) {
        if (!this._canWrite()) return this._denyWrite();
        opts = opts || {};
        var gr = this._findVit(number);
        if (!gr) return { ok: false, error: 'Vulnerable item ' + this._normVit(number) + ' not found.' };
        var msg = [];
        if (opts.group) {
            var g = this._resolveGroup(opts.group);
            if (!g.ok) return g;
            gr.assignment_group = g.sys_id;
            msg.push('group ' + g.name);
        }
        if (opts.user) {
            var u = this._resolveUser(opts.user);
            if (!u.ok) return u;
            gr.assigned_to = u.sys_id;
            msg.push(u.name);
        }
        if (!msg.length) return { ok: false, error: 'Give me a user or a group to assign to.' };
        gr.work_notes = '[Netra] Assigned to ' + msg.join(' / ') + ' by ' + this.userName + ' via voice.';
        gr.update();
        return { ok: true, number: String(gr.number), message: String(gr.number) + ' assigned to ' + msg.join(' and ') + '.' };
    },

    setVulnerableItemState: function (number, stateWord, note) {
        if (!this._canWrite()) return this._denyWrite();
        var gr = this._findVit(number);
        if (!gr) return { ok: false, error: 'Vulnerable item ' + this._normVit(number) + ' not found.' };
        var st = this.STATE_WORD[String(stateWord || '').toLowerCase()];
        if (!st) return { ok: false, error: 'I did not recognise the state "' + stateWord + '". Try open, investigate, defer, resolve, or close.' };
        gr.state = st;
        if (note) gr.work_notes = '[Netra] ' + note;
        else gr.work_notes = '[Netra] State set to ' + this.STATE_LABEL[st] + ' by ' + this.userName + ' via voice.';
        gr.update();
        return { ok: true, number: String(gr.number), state: this.STATE_LABEL[st], message: String(gr.number) + ' is now ' + this.STATE_LABEL[st] + '.' };
    },

    /**
     * Defer (risk-accept) a VIT. Reason is mandatory. Optional untilDate
     * ('YYYY-MM-DD') sets remediation_target when the field exists, so the
     * deferral has a review date the overdue/aging reports can see.
     */
    deferVulnerableItem: function (number, reason, untilDate) {
        if (!this._canWrite()) return this._denyWrite();
        if (!reason || String(reason).trim().length < 3) return { ok: false, error: 'Deferring needs a reason for the audit trail. Why are we accepting this risk?' };
        var gr = this._findVit(number);
        if (!gr) return { ok: false, error: 'Vulnerable item ' + this._normVit(number) + ' not found.' };
        var until = String(untilDate || '').trim();
        var haveUntil = /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(until);
        gr.state = this.STATE.DEFERRED;
        if (haveUntil && gr.isValidField('remediation_target')) gr.remediation_target = until + ' 00:00:00';
        gr.work_notes = '[Netra] Deferred (risk accepted) by ' + this.userName +
                        (haveUntil ? ' until ' + until : '') + '. Reason: ' + reason;
        gr.update();
        return {
            ok: true,
            number: String(gr.number),
            state: 'deferred',
            until: haveUntil ? until : '',
            message: String(gr.number) + ' is now deferred' + (haveUntil ? ' until ' + until : '') + '.'
        };
    },

    addVulnerabilityNote: function (number, note) {
        if (!this._canWrite()) return this._denyWrite();
        if (!note || String(note).trim().length < 1) return { ok: false, error: 'The note is empty.' };
        var gr = this._findVit(number);
        if (!gr) return { ok: false, error: 'Vulnerable item ' + this._normVit(number) + ' not found.' };
        gr.work_notes = '[Netra] ' + note;
        gr.update();
        return { ok: true, number: String(gr.number), message: 'Note added to ' + String(gr.number) + '.' };
    },

    /**
     * Close a VIT with an audit note. resolutionWord 'fixed'/'resolved'/
     * 'remediated' -> resolved; 'closed'/'close' (or empty) -> closed.
     * The note (>= 3 chars) is mandatory and lands in work notes and, when
     * the field exists, close_notes. substate 'fixed' is set when available.
     */
    closeVulnerableItem: function (number, resolutionWord, note) {
        if (!this._canWrite()) return this._denyWrite();
        note = String(note || '').trim();
        if (note.length < 3) return { ok: false, error: 'Closing needs a short note for the audit trail. What did we do?' };
        var word = String(resolutionWord || '').toLowerCase().trim();
        var st;
        if (word === 'fixed' || word === 'resolved' || word === 'remediated') st = this.STATE.RESOLVED;
        else if (word === 'closed' || word === 'close' || word === '') st = this.STATE.CLOSED;
        else return { ok: false, error: 'Say fixed, resolved, remediated, or closed — how should I close this item?' };
        var gr = this._findVit(number);
        if (!gr) return { ok: false, error: 'Vulnerable item ' + this._normVit(number) + ' not found.' };
        gr.state = st;
        if (gr.isValidField('substate')) gr.substate = 'fixed';
        gr.work_notes = '[Netra] Closed as ' + this.STATE_LABEL[st] + ' by ' + this.userName + ' via voice. Note: ' + note;
        if (gr.isValidField('close_notes')) gr.close_notes = note;
        gr.update();
        return { ok: true, number: String(gr.number), state: this.STATE_LABEL[st], message: String(gr.number) + ' is now ' + this.STATE_LABEL[st] + '.' };
    },

    /**
     * Mark a VIT as a false positive: closed, substate 'false_positive' when
     * the field exists, mandatory reason on the audit trail.
     */
    markFalsePositive: function (number, reason) {
        if (!this._canWrite()) return this._denyWrite();
        reason = String(reason || '').trim();
        if (reason.length < 3) return { ok: false, error: 'Marking a false positive needs a reason for the audit trail. Why is this not a real finding?' };
        var gr = this._findVit(number);
        if (!gr) return { ok: false, error: 'Vulnerable item ' + this._normVit(number) + ' not found.' };
        gr.state = this.STATE.CLOSED;
        if (gr.isValidField('substate')) gr.substate = 'false_positive';
        gr.work_notes = '[Netra] Marked FALSE POSITIVE by ' + this.userName + '. Reason: ' + reason;
        if (gr.isValidField('close_notes')) gr.close_notes = 'False positive: ' + reason;
        gr.update();
        return { ok: true, number: String(gr.number), state: 'closed', message: String(gr.number) + ' marked as a false positive and closed.' };
    },

    /** Reopen a closed/resolved/deferred VIT with a mandatory reason. */
    reopenVulnerableItem: function (number, reason) {
        if (!this._canWrite()) return this._denyWrite();
        reason = String(reason || '').trim();
        if (reason.length < 3) return { ok: false, error: 'Reopening needs a reason for the audit trail. Why is this back?' };
        var gr = this._findVit(number);
        if (!gr) return { ok: false, error: 'Vulnerable item ' + this._normVit(number) + ' not found.' };
        gr.state = this.STATE.OPEN;
        gr.active = true;
        gr.work_notes = '[Netra] Reopened by ' + this.userName + '. Reason: ' + reason;
        gr.update();
        return { ok: true, number: String(gr.number), state: 'open', message: String(gr.number) + ' is open again.' };
    },

    /**
     * Raise a normal change request to remediate a VIT. Carries the CVE
     * summary and solution into the change, links CI and assignment group
     * from the VIT, and cross-references both records.
     */
    createChangeForVit: function (number, shortDesc) {
        if (!this._canWrite()) return this._denyWrite();
        var gr = this._findVit(number);
        if (!gr) return { ok: false, error: 'Vulnerable item ' + this._normVit(number) + ' not found.' };

        // pull the CVE entry so the change explains itself
        var cveId = '', cveSummary = '', solution = '';
        if (!gr.vulnerability.nil()) {
            var e = new GlideRecord(this.ENTRY);
            if (e.get(String(gr.vulnerability))) {
                cveId      = String(e.id);
                cveSummary = String(e.summary || '').substring(0, 600);
                solution   = this._stripHtml(String(e.solution || '')).substring(0, 600);
            }
        }

        var ch = new GlideRecord('change_request');
        if (!ch.isValid()) return { ok: false, error: 'The change request table is not available on this instance.' };
        ch.initialize();
        if (ch.isValidField('type')) ch.type = 'normal';
        var head = cveId || String(gr.short_description || '').substring(0, 60);
        ch.short_description = String(shortDesc || '').trim() || ('Remediate ' + String(gr.number) + ' — ' + head);
        var desc = '';
        if (cveSummary) desc += cveSummary + '\n';
        if (solution)   desc += 'Solution: ' + solution + '\n';
        desc += 'Raised by Netra for ' + this.userName + ' from vulnerable item ' + String(gr.number) + '.';
        ch.description = desc;
        if (!gr.cmdb_ci.nil()) ch.cmdb_ci = String(gr.cmdb_ci);
        if (!gr.assignment_group.nil()) ch.assignment_group = String(gr.assignment_group);
        var chId = ch.insert();
        if (!chId) return { ok: false, error: 'The change could not be created. The platform may have blocked it.' };
        var chNum = String(ch.number);

        gr.work_notes = '[Netra] Change ' + chNum + ' created by ' + this.userName + ' via voice to remediate this item.';
        if (gr.isValidField('change_request')) gr.change_request = String(chId);
        gr.update();

        return { ok: true, change_number: chNum, message: 'Change ' + chNum + ' created for ' + String(gr.number) + '.' };
    },

    // ============================================================
    //  Bulk operations (R5) — preview first, then apply
    // ============================================================
    /**
     * Count + sample what a bulk action WOULD touch. filter:
     * { cve, ci, band, state, group, older_than_days, scope } — at least one
     * required. token echoes the canonical filter JSON for the widget layer's
     * preview-then-confirm protocol.
     */
    bulkPreview: function (filter) {
        if (!this._canRead()) return this._denyRead();
        var f = this._normalizeBulkFilter(filter);
        if (this._bulkFilterIsEmpty(f)) return { ok: false, error: 'Give me at least one filter first: a CVE, an asset, a risk band, a state, a group, or an age in days.' };
        var count = this._bulkCount(f);
        var sample = [];
        if (count > 0) {
            var gr = new GlideRecord(this.VIT);
            if (this._applyBulkFilter(gr, f)) {
                gr.orderByDesc('risk_score');
                gr.setLimit(3);
                gr.query();
                while (gr.next()) sample.push(this._shapeVit(gr));
            }
        }
        return { ok: true, count: count, sample: sample, filter_echo: this._describeBulkFilter(f), token: JSON.stringify(f) };
    },

    /**
     * Apply one action to every item matching the filter (hard cap 50).
     * action: 'assign' (params {user?, group?}), 'defer' (params {reason}),
     * 'state' (params {state}), 'note' (params {note}).
     * The widget layer enforces preview-first; params re-validated here.
     */
    bulkApply: function (filter, action, params) {
        if (!this._canWrite()) return this._denyWrite();
        params = params || {};
        action = String(action || '').toLowerCase();
        if (action !== 'assign' && action !== 'defer' && action !== 'state' && action !== 'note') {
            return { ok: false, error: 'I can bulk assign, defer, set state, or add a note. Which would you like?' };
        }
        var f = this._normalizeBulkFilter(filter);
        if (this._bulkFilterIsEmpty(f)) return { ok: false, error: 'Give me at least one filter first: a CVE, an asset, a risk band, a state, a group, or an age in days.' };

        // validate the action parameters up front (fail before touching rows)
        var groupId = '', groupName = '', userId = '', userLabel = '';
        var stateVal = '', noteText = '', reason = '';
        if (action === 'assign') {
            if (!params.user && !params.group) return { ok: false, error: 'Give me a user or a group to assign to.' };
            if (params.group) {
                var g = this._resolveGroup(params.group);
                if (!g.ok) return g;
                groupId = g.sys_id; groupName = g.name;
            }
            if (params.user) {
                var u = this._resolveUser(params.user);
                if (!u.ok) return u;
                userId = u.sys_id; userLabel = u.name;
            }
        } else if (action === 'defer') {
            reason = String(params.reason || '').trim();
            if (reason.length < 3) return { ok: false, error: 'Bulk deferring needs a reason for the audit trail. Why are we accepting this risk?' };
        } else if (action === 'state') {
            stateVal = this.STATE_WORD[String(params.state || '').toLowerCase()];
            if (!stateVal) return { ok: false, error: 'I did not recognise that state. Try open, investigate, defer, resolve, or close.' };
        } else {
            noteText = String(params.note || '').trim();
            if (!noteText) return { ok: false, error: 'The note is empty.' };
        }

        var total = this._bulkCount(f);
        if (!total) return { ok: true, changed: 0, skipped: 0, message: 'Nothing matched that filter, so nothing changed.' };

        var assignDesc = [];
        if (groupName) assignDesc.push('group ' + groupName);
        if (userLabel) assignDesc.push(userLabel);

        var gr = new GlideRecord(this.VIT);
        if (!this._applyBulkFilter(gr, f)) return { ok: true, changed: 0, skipped: 0, message: 'Nothing matched that filter, so nothing changed.' };
        gr.orderByDesc('risk_score');
        gr.setLimit(50);  // hard safety cap on bulk mutations
        gr.query();
        var changed = 0, skipped = 0;
        while (gr.next()) {
            try {
                if (action === 'assign') {
                    if (groupId) gr.assignment_group = groupId;
                    if (userId)  gr.assigned_to = userId;
                    gr.work_notes = '[Netra] Bulk assign by ' + this.userName + ': assigned to ' + assignDesc.join(' / ') + ' via voice.';
                } else if (action === 'defer') {
                    gr.state = this.STATE.DEFERRED;
                    gr.work_notes = '[Netra] Bulk defer by ' + this.userName + ': risk accepted. Reason: ' + reason;
                } else if (action === 'state') {
                    gr.state = stateVal;
                    gr.work_notes = '[Netra] Bulk state by ' + this.userName + ': set to ' + (this.STATE_LABEL[stateVal] || stateVal) + ' via voice.';
                } else {
                    gr.work_notes = '[Netra] Bulk note by ' + this.userName + ': ' + noteText;
                }
                gr.update();
                changed++;
            } catch (ex) {
                skipped++;
            }
        }

        var unit = (changed === 1) ? 'item' : 'items';
        var msg;
        if (action === 'assign')      msg = 'Assigned ' + changed + ' ' + unit + ' to ' + assignDesc.join(' and ') + '.';
        else if (action === 'defer')  msg = 'Deferred ' + changed + ' ' + unit + '.';
        else if (action === 'state')  msg = 'Set ' + changed + ' ' + unit + ' to ' + (this.STATE_LABEL[stateVal] || stateVal) + '.';
        else                          msg = 'Added the note to ' + changed + ' ' + unit + '.';
        if (skipped) msg += ' ' + skipped + ' could not be updated.';
        if (total > 50) msg += ' That was the first 50 of ' + total + ' matching items. Say it again to do the next batch.';
        return { ok: true, changed: changed, skipped: skipped, message: msg };
    },

    /** Normalize a bulk filter into a canonical object (fixed key order). */
    _normalizeBulkFilter: function (filter) {
        filter = filter || {};
        var f = {};
        if (filter.scope) {
            var sc = String(filter.scope).toLowerCase();
            if (sc === 'me' || sc === 'group' || sc === 'all') f.scope = sc;
        }
        if (filter.state) f.state = this.STATE_WORD[String(filter.state).toLowerCase()] || this._q(filter.state);
        if (filter.band) {
            var bd = String(filter.band).toLowerCase();
            if (bd === 'critical' || bd === 'high' || bd === 'medium' || bd === 'low') f.band = bd;
        }
        if (filter.cve)   f.cve = this._q(filter.cve).toUpperCase().replace(/\s+/g, '');
        if (filter.ci)    f.ci = this._q(filter.ci);
        if (filter.group) f.group = this._q(filter.group);
        if (filter.older_than_days) {
            var d = parseInt(filter.older_than_days, 10);
            if (d > 0) f.older_than_days = d;
        }
        return f;
    },

    _bulkFilterIsEmpty: function (f) {
        return !(f.scope || f.state || f.band || f.cve || f.ci || f.group || f.older_than_days);
    },

    /**
     * Apply a normalized bulk filter to a GlideRecord/GlideAggregate.
     * Returns false when the filter can provably match nothing.
     */
    _applyBulkFilter: function (gr, f) {
        gr.addQuery('active', true);
        if (f.scope === 'me') {
            gr.addEncodedQuery(this._meQuery());
        } else if (f.scope === 'group') {
            var groups = this._myGroupIds();
            if (!groups.length) return false;
            gr.addQuery('assignment_group', 'IN', groups.join(','));
        }
        if (f.state) gr.addQuery('state', f.state);
        if (f.band) {
            var ranges = { critical: [80, 100], high: [60, 79], medium: [40, 59], low: [1, 39] };
            if (ranges[f.band]) { gr.addQuery('risk_score', '>=', ranges[f.band][0]); gr.addQuery('risk_score', '<=', ranges[f.band][1]); }
        }
        if (f.cve)   gr.addQuery('vulnerability.id', f.cve);
        if (f.ci)    gr.addQuery('cmdb_ci.name', 'CONTAINS', f.ci);
        if (f.group) gr.addQuery('assignment_group.name', 'CONTAINS', f.group);
        if (f.older_than_days) this._applyOlderThan(gr, f.older_than_days);
        return true;
    },

    _bulkCount: function (f) {
        var agg = new GlideAggregate(this.VIT);
        if (!this._applyBulkFilter(agg, f)) return 0;
        agg.addAggregate('COUNT');
        agg.query();
        return agg.next() ? (parseInt(agg.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) || 0) : 0;
    },

    /** Spoken description of a normalized bulk filter for read-back. */
    _describeBulkFilter: function (f) {
        var parts = [];
        if (f.band)  parts.push(f.band + ' risk');
        if (f.state) parts.push('in state ' + (this.STATE_LABEL[f.state] || f.state));
        if (f.cve)   parts.push('for ' + f.cve);
        if (f.ci)    parts.push('on assets matching ' + f.ci);
        if (f.group) parts.push('assigned to groups matching ' + f.group);
        if (f.older_than_days) parts.push('older than ' + f.older_than_days + ' days');
        if (f.scope === 'me') parts.push('assigned to you');
        else if (f.scope === 'group') parts.push('in your groups');
        if (!parts.length) return 'all active vulnerable items';
        return 'active vulnerable items ' + parts.join(', ');
    },

    // ============================================================
    //  Utility
    // ============================================================
    _stripHtml: function (s) {
        return String(s || '').replace(/<[^>]+>/g, ' ').replace(/ /g, ' ').replace(/&/g, '&').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
    },

    type: 'NetraVulnerability'
};
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-07-10 03:28:40</sys_created_on><sys_id>419c876c93428b10e3aef0aefaba1093</sys_id><sys_mod_count>2</sys_mod_count><sys_name>NetraVulnerability</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Netra Voice Assistant" source="x_196061_netra_v1">26a2121093424710e3aef0aefaba106a</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Netra Voice Assistant">26a2121093424710e3aef0aefaba106a</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_419c876c93428b10e3aef0aefaba1093</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-07-10 12:30:00</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
